# Anycode v0.0.28

This release brings major rendering and virtual scrolling performance optimizations, sticky file headers and transaction support for multibuffer review, diff mode controls across review sessions, LSP navigation fixes, and ACP chat UX enhancements.

## Performance and rendering

- Implemented binary token encoding for syntax highlighting to eliminate forced reflows during virtual scrolling.
- Optimized virtual scrolling pipeline, line rendering, diff rows, and scrollbar markers.
- Added sparse ghost index optimization for folding ghosts and diff lines.
- Fixed scrollbar thumb positioning and scaling on zoom and window resize.
- Added virtual scrolling to the git changes panel.

## Multibuffer and code review

- Implemented sticky file headers for multibuffer review with refined styling and theme tokens.
- Migrated multibuffer editor coordinates to point-based representation with atomic transaction support.
- Added diff mode propagation (`diff`, `combine`, `plain`) to multibuffer panels.
- Fixed cursor desynchronization on Enter and edits in multibuffer mode, and synchronized cursor focus.
- Preserved review scroll positions across panel and tab switches.

## Editor, LSP, and Git

- Fixed LSP document navigation and normalized Windows URI parsing.
- Preserved editor diff mode when navigating to definitions.
- Improved cursor positioning synchronicity and focus reliability.
- Restored baseline file content from Git upon WebSocket reconnection.
- Updated documentation for Roslyn LSP installation and global tool PATH guidance.

## ACP (Agent Client Protocol) and chat

- Added copy button for code blocks in agent messages.
- Added collapsing for long user messages and refined auto-scroll behavior.
- Persisted agent settings panel layout preferences.

**Full comparison:** `v0.0.27...v0.0.28`
